latestPost.text: The strongest development platforms pair available power with visible customer demand. CFO Patrick Fleury explains how the competitive processes behind $WULF's existing portfolio have expanded the company’s universe of prospective customers, creating relationships (e.g. @AnthropicAI @Google @fluidstack) that can carry forward as new sites come online. Our Muskie site is a clear example. With an initial development path of ~500 MW and the potential to scale to 1 GW, the site gives us another opportunity to convert existing customer interest into long-term contracted growth. The strategic advantage is the combination of both sides of the equation - a growing pipeline of customer demand and large-scale, power-backed capacity to serve it - creating multiple pathways to convert commercial momentum into contracted growth and long-term value for shareholders.
